{{Nav Games Header}}

<b>Enemy Gauntlets</b> are challenges in which [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must defeat [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in order to access a new [[Areas (Silksong)|area]], acquire an [[Items (Silksong)|item]], complete a [[Quests_(Silksong)|Quest]], or simply further the main story of the game. Most enemy gauntlets include multiple waves of enemies, and a select few feature a [[Bosses (Silksong)|boss]], generally as the last wave. Hornet is often, but not always, locked into the arena of the enemy gauntlet after entering, with the exits only opening once the gauntlet is fully completed. There are 49 enemy gauntlets in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.
